name: Motorcycle
description: Any motor-operated vehicle of the bicycle or tricycle type with a seat the rider sits astride or a platform to stand on, including motor bikes and electric motorized bicycles, other than a motorized bicycle, low-speed electric bicycle or low-speed electric scooter. An electric two-wheeler without pedals, or a pedaled one past the motorized bicycle limits, is one.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle the rider sits astride, or a platform the rider stands on, on two or three wheels
Takes in motor bikes, bicycles with a motor attached and electric motorized bicycles; excludes motorized bicycles, low-speed electric bicycles and low-speed electric scooters
restrictions.citation: N.J.S.A. 39:1-1, as amended by P.L.2025, c.285

restrictions.rule: An electric moped-style two-wheeler without pedals can't be a motorized bicycle, which must be a pedal bicycle, so it is a motorcycle
Riders need a motorcycle endorsement on a driver's license or a separate motorcycle license; applicants must be 17 or older, with parental consent under 18
Riders under 18 must complete the Basic Rider Course
Riders and passengers must wear a securely fitted, approved protective helmet with a chin strap and reflectorization on both sides
Titled, registered and insured with the Motor Vehicle Commission
No state safety inspection since August 1, 2010
